question: List every client's id and full name together with the name of their agency.
reply:
```sql
SELECT "people"."client"."client_id", "people"."client"."full_name", "org"."agency"."name"
FROM "people"."client"
JOIN "org"."agency" ON "people"."client"."agency_id" = "org"."agency"."agency_id";
```
